kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحونصل (form IIIq)
# أَحْوَنْصِلُ (ʔaḥwanṣilu) /ʔaħ.wan.sˤi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# أَحْوَنْصِلَ (ʔaḥwanṣila) /ʔaħ.wan.sˤi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# أَحْوَنْصِلْ (ʔaḥwanṣil) /ʔaħ.wan.sˤil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
